observedMismatch: When the Home Indicator owns an opaque TabBar surface, its lower corners sit inside the phone-screen instead of following the screen's inner rounded edge.
qaMiss: The previous surface-state QA checked background continuity, bottom anchoring, visibility, and scrolling, but did not assert indicator and phone-screen horizontal geometry equality.
rootCause: The outer indicator is an absolute child of the bordered phone. Its containing block already resolves left/right against the padding box, which is the phone-screen edge. Applying --mockup-frame-border-scaled again produced a second inset.
fix: Set left and right to 0 while retaining bottom:0 and the screen inner radius token.
